segments.name: Altcoin mining
segments.description: Designs and sells altcoin mining machines built on in-house ASIC chips, mainly to distributors and individual end-users.
segments.evidence: Our altcoin mining machines are built using our proprietary product solutions and integrates our in-house designed ASIC chips.

revenueModel.text: The Group derives revenue from its customers by providing mining products and a small portion of related maintenance fee income.
revenueModel.evidence: The Group derives revenue from its customers by providing mining products, as well as a small portion of the related maintenance fee income and products of WEB 3 applications.

changes.text: In 2024, the company discontinued standalone ASIC chip sales, so revenue came entirely from altcoin mining machines.
changes.evidence: By June 2024, we had fully discontinued the sale of standalone ASIC chips, with our revenue now generated entirely from altcoin mining machines that integrate our ASIC chips.

changes.text: In January 2026, the Group agreed to divest its non-core chip R&D business to an entity controlled by its chairman and chief executive officer.
changes.evidence: on January 5, 2026, the Group entered into a business transfer agreement (the "Agreement") with Shanghai TopsFuture Microelectronics Co., Ltd. ("TopsFuture"), an entity controlled by Mr. Qiang Ding, the Company's chairman and chief executive officer, to divest its non-core chip R&D business for a total consideration of up to RMB 18.0 million.
